integrity_rules: Only authoritative verified results may enter as direct electoral or referendum outcomes.
Record the scope of the decision actually made; do not expand an outcome into a broader mandate by inference.
A measurable public-driven institutional outcome requires evidence both of the institutional change and of the causal contribution of public pressure.
Polling, rhetoric, media sentiment and absence of protest cannot enter this ledger as outcomes.
Corrections are append-only and retain superseded records for audit.
